name: Promo Strike Price

behavior.description: Keep the old price readable while a decorative strike overlay draws across it from left to right, then hand the completed strike back to the authored deletion decoration.
behavior.targetSelection: Only old-price is required. Apply to its matching elements within the selected component; price and every other hook remain unchanged. No new-price step is implied.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; easing on a keyframe applies to the next interval. strikeReveal is the visible fraction of the fixed overlay line, not the target text.

strikeOverlay.owner: adapter-owned decorative overlay anchored to a layout-preserving motion layer around the existing old-price element
strikeOverlay.semantics: Keep the original del element, its text and accessibility semantics unchanged throughout. The overlay is aria-hidden, has no text and ignores pointer events.
strikeOverlay.geometry: At setup capture the authored text's inline bounds and deletion-line position, thickness and color. Place a fixed full-length horizontal line at that strike position, matching the authored decoration. For wrapped old-price text, capture each line fragment and reveal its strike in source reading order using cumulative line lengths.
strikeOverlay.reveal: strikeReveal 0 conceals all overlay line length; 1 reveals all of it. Reveal left to right by an overlay-only mask or scaleX with left-center origin. Do not scale text, tween layout width or overwrite the target's decorative clip-path.
strikeOverlay.start: At motion start temporarily suppress only the old-price element's visual line-through while leaving del semantics intact. Preserve any other authored text decorations and saved styles. Keep the text visible at opacity 1; create the overlay with strikeReveal 0.
strikeOverlay.completion: After the fully drawn strike holds, atomically restore the authored line-through and remove the overlay at duration, leaving a permanent visible strike and the original del semantics. Restore only styles this motion temporarily owns. On a backward seek recreate the overlay and the temporary decoration state directly from local time; never rely on a prior completion callback.

adaptation: Translations use design pixels at 1080x1920 scaled with the frame; scale multiplies authored base scale, rotation is additive degrees, and opacity is absolute. Overlay geometry inherits the authored old-price styling, including rotated parent poses. Preserve layout, existing decorations other than the temporary line-through suppression, and all decorative masks or clip-paths. No framework or additional animation hook is required. Initialize at assigned start and derive text, overlay and cleanup state deterministically from local time.
